evidence: claudebot-dip-backtest.json: rsi2<5, close>SMA200, exit close>SMA5 or RSI2>70 or 10 days, 5% stop. Test 2025-26: 41 trades, 85% wins, +1.0%/trade, PF 6.3 (mostly rising market; bear-market risk remains).
changeLog: 2026-11-02: CEO launched the Dip desk live at $25 per trade after the backtest held up on 30/30 parameter combos out of sample.

2026-11-02: CEO hired a Sector Analyst. The live rule, with frozen parameters, passed both train (2023-24) and test (2025-26) on SMH, XLK and KRE (test avg +2.1%, +0.7%, +0.6% per trade). Added to the scan; still $25 and one position at a time. 9 other sector funds failed and were not added.
2026-11-02: Board allowed more positions. CEO set up to 3 dip positions at once (one per ETF, $25 each), always keeping $86 free while the options desk is flat so the dip desk never blocks a spread.
2026-11-02: Board: reinvest wins. Each dip trade is now 20% of account value (minimum $25), so trade size grows as the account grows. Options keep the cash reserve first.
2026-11-02: Options desk moved to paper (Robinhood blocks agent spread orders), so the Dip desk no longer holds $86 back for it and can use up to 3 positions of 20% each.

2026-11-02: Board: use the whole account for the Dip desk. Up to 5 positions at once (one per ETF, 20% of account each, so up to ~100% invested), no cash held back for spreads (new spreads paused), and when several ETFs signal the same day the strongest on unseen 2025-26 tests goes first: SMH, IWM, SPY, DIA, XLK, KRE, QQQ. Stops (5%) unchanged.

2026-11-02: Board: don't hold cash when there is something to buy. When ETFs signal, the free cash (minus $1) is split across today's signals instead of 20% each, so one signal can use nearly all the cash. Still one position per ETF, max 5, 5% stops.
2026-11-02: CEO added a loss brake to all-cash sizing: after 3 losing dip trades in a row, buys drop back to the small size (20% / $25 min) until a winning trade.
